A SECTION, NOT THE WALL. The Ming wall is 8 850 km long; no scale renders that and no frame holds it. What this Atlas builds is 400 m of the cited Jinshanling profile with three watchtowers, and says so in its own title. Anything else would be a claim the model does not support.

The watchtower dimensions and spacing are uncited: the source read gives an estimated 25 000 watchtowers and no typical height or interval.

The towers stand BEHIND the wall rather than inside it. A real Ming watchtower straddles the rampart; two bricks cannot share a cubic millimetre, so the model abuts them at the wall's cited 6 m base width.
